free_tier.stated: 250 MB per file, 10 minutes per video on the free plan. No storage pool — the unit is the individual clip.

retention.stated: Videos are auto-deleted after 90 days even on a free account ('archived after 24 hours' when anonymous).

egress.terms: Free, unlimited playback; no egress meter.

tooling: yt-dlp `Streamable` extractor (verified present). Undocumented upload endpoint only.
chaining: Unlimited clips at 250 MB — mathematically unbounded but practically useless: 500 GB would need 2,000 separate uploads, each expiring in 90 days.
limits_note: 250 MB AND 10 minutes, both hard. Videos are auto-deleted after 90 days even on a free account ('archived after 24 hours' when anonymous).
reliability_note: Systematic 90-day deletion makes it a transfer service, not storage. Data disappears on a timer by design.

evidence.proved: 'maximum file size of 250 MB and a duration of 10 minutes'; 'Videos uploaded by free users are automatically deleted after 3 months (90 days)'
